[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 180
- Description: Ealvin (Liuyang organic farm) — 3h on hosting cacao circles at his venue + collaborations
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1835
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1836
  
  Details:
  3-hour business conversation with **Ealvin**, who operates an organic farm in **Liuyang**, on potentially hosting **cacao circle** experiences at his venue, plus other collaborations.
  
  === THE PHOTO IS NOT A FARM — correction to my own first assumption ===
  The attachment auto-OCR returned **0.0% / no text detected**, which I initially took to suggest a landscape photograph. That was wrong, and I want it on the record that I checked rather than assumed. The auto-OCR failed because the image is 2880x2160 with layered natural texture; it is in fact an interior/interpersonal scene.
  
  Vision read of the actual image (literal description only):
    - Two men seated at a long wooden table in an **open-air pavilion** with a bamboo/thatched roof, large windows, outdoor greenery.
    - Both holding **small dark ceramic cups with a brown liquid** — i.e. drinking cacao, not merely discussing it.
    - **Two brown kraft cacao pouches** on the table between them, labelled: **NET WT 8.8 OZ (250 g)**, **100% ORGANIC**, **CEREMONIAL GRADE**, **CACAO**.
    - Background: other people seated at tables, wooden stools, potted plants, a wooden staircase.
    - **No QR code labels visible** on the pouches — the bags appear to be standard printed retail packaging, not inventory-tagged units.
  
  So the evidenced context is a **cacao tasting / gathering in a pavilion space with third-party attendees present** — which is exactly the physical format a hosted "cacao circle" would use. That is meaningful supporting evidence for the proposal actually being grounded in a real venue, not just a verbal idea. It is NOT evidence of a signed arrangement, and no QR/bag transfer should be inferred from it.
  
  === WHY LIUYANG MATTERS GEOGRAPHICALLY (verified) ===
  Liuyang (浏阳) is a county-level city in **Hunan Province, under the administration of Changsha** prefecture, roughly **50 km from Changsha city**.
  
  This is the same Hunan/Changsha cluster that already appears twice in this thread:
    - the **Changsha-based WeChat contact** (`+86 18926843778`, ID ycy18926843778) previously mis-attributed to Nathan LUI in an earlier filing;
    - the **China-side food distributor** named in the Cristiano-CIC thread awaiting heavy-metal reports.
  Liuyang therefore is not a new, unconnected geography — it sits inside a China footprint that is already being worked. That raises the value of this conversation: a venue ~50 km from Changsha could host experiences for the same people already in the procurement pipeline, rather than requiring a separate market to be built from zero.
  
  === WHAT A "CACAO CIRCLE" IS IN DAO TERMS (context-grounded, not invented) ===
  Per agentic_ai_context, cacao circles are an established part of the vocabulary — real-world gatherings, cacao circles and press pickups are tracked as community/outreach events (OPENCLAW_WHATSAPP.md), and published "cacao circle" event pages exist (EVENTS.md). Content planning explicitly includes "Stories of cacao circle hosts using Agroverse cacao" and seasonal/community circle invitations. So this is an **existing, documented format with host-facing precedent** — Ealvin would be joining a known programme shape, not inventing one.
  
  === THE THREE COLLABORATION ANGLES THIS OPENS (and the open questions) ===
  1. VENUE HOSTING — Ealvin's organic farm as a cacao circle location.
     Open: capacity, indoor/outdoor contingency (Hunan has hot summers and cold damp winters), and whether attendees are paying guests, farm visitors, or invited community.
  2. CACAO SUPPLY — circles need ceremonial-grade cacao, and the pouches photographed are 250 g / 8.8 oz ceremonial grade. If circles scale, that is a recurring consumable order — the commercially durable part of this, far more than a one-off event.
     Open: who buys the cacao, at what price, and shipped from where. This is the number that decides whether it is a partnership or a favour.
  3. ORGANIC-FARM CREDIBILITY — an organic farm venue plus verified organic ceremonial cacao is a coherent story, and it is also the kind of host relationship that feeds content (the documented "stories of cacao circle hosts" line).
  
  === COMPLIANCE / PRACTICAL NOTE, FLAGGED NOT ASSERTED ===
  Running tasting or ceremonial events in mainland China involves food-service and possibly health/labelling considerations, and if cacao is sold (rather than served), Chinese labelling rules (GB 7718 / GB 28050, cocoa-solids per GB/T 19343) apply. I am flagging this as something to check locally rather than stating a conclusion — I do not have a verified position on the licensing requirements for hosted tasting events in Hunan, and this thread has already produced several confident inferences that proved wrong (the Nathan identity, the WeChat/FaceTime misread, the "farm photo" assumption above). Worth asking Ealvin directly since he operates locally.
  
  === EVIDENCE LIMITATION ===
  Auto-OCR: 0.0% confidence, no text. Re-read via vision (Grok) plus a targeted second pass confirming no signage/banner text anywhere in frame. The bag label text is the only legible text in the image and was recovered consistently. Nothing in this entry rests on assumed signage or on unreadable detail.
  
  === TIME BASIS ===
  180 minutes as directed by the governor. TDG derived from the dao_client rubric SSOT (rubric.py: Time (Minutes) = minutes/60*100 = 180/60*100 = **300.00**), not supplied by hand.
  
  === DUPLICATE CHECK ===
  Searched the autopilot service log from 2026-11-01 for "ealvin" / "liuyang" / "liu yang" among create_dao_submission calls. Four log hits, **all of them this session's own grep commands** — no actual prior filing. This is the first filing for Ealvin.
  
  === CONTEXT SEARCH NOTE ===
  "Ealvin", "LiuYang"/"Liu Yang" and "organic farm" all return **zero** hits in agentic_ai_context, and "Ealvin" returns zero in org-wide code search. So this is a genuinely new contact with no prior record — the entry is written to be self-contained for that reason, including the verified geography that context search could not supply.
  
  PR FIELD NOTE: operational/partnership follow-up with no code change, so no PR of its own. The two PR URLs cited carry PDF/markdown artefact work from this same thread and are included only because the reporting tool requires a pull URL and rejects non-pull links.
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh
